content.short: Hyper Jump is a community-driven, multi-chain DeFi protocol with a robust token ecosystem.
content.description: Hyper Jump is a multi-chain DeFi protocol with a token ecosystem on Binance Smart Chain and Fantom. It bundles tools such as Hyperswap for token swapping, Mech Workshop for staking, Star Vaults for auto-compounding vaults, and Unrekt to reveal and revoke addresses that can spend your tokens. The HyperBurn token is deflationary, burning a portion of every transaction and distributing rewards to HYPR holders while funding development. The project also pursues gaming partnerships across supported chains.
